review_candidates.title: Mrežni inženjer
review_candidates.description: CROATIA osiguranje lider je na domaćem tržištu osiguranja, a naš IT & Digital tim okuplja više od 160 stručnjaka koji osiguravaju pouzdan rad poslovnih aplikacija, digitalnih servisa i infrastrukture koja svakodnevno podržava poslovanje društva i povezanih članica grupe. U Službi za ICT infrastrukturu radimo na sustavima koji su temelj dostupnosti, sigurnosti i digitalne transformacije kompanije. Tražimo višeg mrežnog inženjera ili inženjerku za rad na kompleksnoj enterprise mrežnoj infrastrukturi koja obuhvaća core switching i routing, dva podatkovna centra, SD-WAN povezivanje, SDN tehnologije, sigurnosna rješenja i mrežu s više stotina poslovnih lokacija. U ovoj ulozi sudjelovat ćeš u projektiranju, održavanju, modernizaciji, sigurnosti i optimizaciji mrežnih servisa koji izravno podržavaju poslovanje CROATIA osiguranja i povezanih društava u grupi. Što ti nudimo mogućnost rada na daljinu, uz povremeni dolazak u ured ili na teren po potrebi naknadu za prijevoz i prehranu božićnicu, uskrsnicu, regres, dar za dijete, potporu zaposlenicima koji su postali roditelji ili posvojitelji plaćeni dopust za posebne slučajeve: vjenčanje, rođenje djeteta, prvi dan škole, selidba, volontiranje, dodatno usavršavanje i školovanje… dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje s vrlo opsežnim pokrićem te sistematskim pregledom svake godine, osiguranje od nesretnog slučaja 24/7 te putno zdravstveno osiguranje za službena putovanja povoljnije uvjete zdravstvenog, obveznog auto i kasko osiguranja te osiguranja imovine za Croatijine zaposlenike i članove njihove obitelji ekskluzivno članstvo u CROATIA osiguranje zatvorenom dobrovoljnom mirovinskom fondu, uz poticaj poslodavca do 180 € godišnje bonus za preporuku novih zaposlenika, nakon što uspješno odrade probni rok u Croatiji pogodnosti u suradnji s partnerima: MultiSport kartica, edukacije, putovanja i smještaj, kulturna događanja, financije i teleoperaterske usluge te brojni drugi obiteljski dan za zaposlenike i njihove obitelji, volonterske i humanitarne akcije, sportski susreti, blagdanska druženja i brojne druge inicijative Tvoje glavne odgovornosti projektiranje, održavanje i unaprjeđenje enterprise mrežne infrastrukture u okruženju koje obuhvaća dva podatkovna centra i više stotina poslovnih lokacija planiranje i implementacija rješenja iz područja core switchinga, routinga, LAN/WAN tehnologija, SD-WAN-a, SDN-a i mrežne sigurnosti nadzor performansi mrežne infrastrukture, analiza kapaciteta, pravovremeno dimenzioniranje i optimizacija mrežnih servisa vođenje i sudjelovanje u projektima modernizacije mrežne infrastrukture, povezivanja lokacija, podatkovnih centara i implementacije novih mrežnih tehnologija proaktivna briga o sigurnosti mrežne infrastrukture, uključujući segmentaciju, visoku dostupnost, prepoznavanje rizika, predlaganje tehničkih protumjera i suradnju sa sigurnosnim timovima analiza i rješavanje složenih mrežnih incidenata u okruženju CO grupe te koordinacija s internim IT timovima i vanjskim partnerima rješavanje složenih inženjerskih pitanja vezanih uz mrežne servise, arhitekturu, dizajn, redundanciju i pouzdanost mreže izvještavanje o SLA parametrima i vođenje pripadajuće dokumentacije koordinacija i nadzor instalacije mrežne opreme u poslovnim prostorima društva u cijeloj Hrvatskoj, uključujući suradnju s vanjskim dobavljačima usluga i povremene izlaske na teren sudjelovanje u evaluaciji i odabiru tehnologija i opreme suradnja s timovima zaduženima za virtualizacijske tehnologije, sigurnosna rješenja, podatkovne centre i ostale infrastrukturne servise pri projektiranju i rješavanju mrežnih zahtjeva Što očekujemo od tebe VSS ili VŠS, poželjno iz područja informatike, računarstva ili sličnog tehničkog usmjerenja; odgovarajuće relevantno iskustvo može biti prednost kod kandidata s drugačijim obrazovnim putem najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva u administraciji, održavanju ili projektiranju enterprise mrežne infrastrukture, uključujući LAN, WAN, data center networking, vatrozide, preklopnike, usmjerivače, bežične mreže i VoIP rješenja iskustvo u radu na mrežnim uređajima (prednost Cisco, Fortinet) dobro poznavanje mrežnih tehnologija i koncepata kao što su switching, routing, wireless, VoIP, network security, BGP, OSPF, STP, VRF, VLAN, QoS, VPN, segmentacija mreže i visoka dostupnost aktivno korištenje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu vozačka dozvola B kategorije sposobnost samostalne organizacije rada u modelu rada na daljinu, uz redovitu komunikaciju s timom, dostupnost za operativne potrebe i spremnost na povremeni dolazak u ured ili na teren Prednosti imaju kandidati koji: posjeduju certifikat iz područja mrežnih tehnologija (npr. CCNP/CCIE ili ekvivalent za 'višu' razinu) imaju iskustvo u izradi disaster recovery rješenja imaju iskustvo u radu sa SD-WAN, SDN, data center networking ili naprednim mrežno-sigurnosnim tehnologijama imaju izražene komunikacijske vještine pokazuju sklonost timskom radu

review_candidates.title: ATM Senior integration engineer
review_candidates.location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
review_candidates.description: Have you been working in systems integration for several years now and do you want to go to another level? Would you like to be part of a project in the aeronautical sector, in air traffic management? Do you like the integration, testing and deployment of critical software systems? If you answered yes, this is your vacancy. You will become part of the Integration and Testing team in charge of putting into operation a flight plan processing and management system. We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website. WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON? In this team you will perform integration, verification, validation and deployment tasks, including, for example: Integration of the different modules of the system as well as with external systems Deployment of the system in factory and client environments Preparation of test environments, including continuous integration Test automation Preparation, execution and reporting of tests carried out both internally and with the client Development of testing tools and configuration management Possibility of travel for version deployments and execution of tests in customer. We would like you to have experience in integration/testing of ATM (Air Traffic Management) systems. WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM? We are looking for experts in validation and ingegration with background and interest in the aeronautical sector. Knowledge of tools related to integration, verification and validation activities Virtualization/containers, such as vsphere, docker or kubernetes Requirements management and/or tests, such as DOORS, qTest, Zephyr, test link or test rail Incident/ticket management, such as Jira, Bugzilla or Redmine Source code management, such as Git or SVN Scripting/automation: like python or ansible WHAT DO WE OFFER? 🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area. 💻 Flexible start and finish times , and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer. 🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support. 🌍 National and international mobility . Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package . 💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews , flexible compensation and discount on brands. 💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee , physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more! ⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com ❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity. WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Bárbara Ferrer Calleja , in charge of this vacancy. Bárbara Ferrer Calleja

review_candidates.title: Director, AI & Data CoE
review_candidates.description: PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Director, AI & Data CoE exists to operate the Group's AI and Data Centre of Excellence as a highperforming, delivery-oriented engine. This role translates Group Data & AI strategy into consistent execution, scalable delivery, and measurable outcomes across the operating companies. The role is execution-first: running the factory that delivers AI, data, and analytics value at scale. Without this position, the CoE risks operating as a loose collection of squads with inconsistent delivery, weak reuse, and limited cross-OpCo scaling, undermining the CSIO operating model and the commercial proposition of Pulse. RESPONSIBILITIES /ACTIVITIES / TASKS 1. CoE Delivery Execution Lead end-to-end delivery of AI, data, and analytics use cases executed by the CoE. Oversee cross-functional delivery squads (Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Coordinators). Ensure delivery meets agreed quality, timeline, and governance standards. Drive predictable delivery throughput and on-time delivery rate across the CoE portfolio. 2. CoE Operations & Squad Management Manage the day-to-day operational rhythm of the AI & Data CoE. Coordinate Project Coordinators and Squad Leads across delivery squads. Ensure effective squad mobilisation when new projects activate (post-P3 gate). Maintain CoE capacity planning, resource allocation, and bench management. 3. Knowledge, IP & Reuse Convert delivery outputs into reusable IP: data products, AI models, templates, and patterns. Maintain and grow the CoE library of shared assets and the future Marketplace. Feed learnings back into delivery methodology and operating standards. Support the AI Product Manager in tracking use-case value and roadmap currency. 4. Cross-OpCo Scaling Lead the scaling of proven solutions across operating companies. Identify replication and acceleration opportunities in the Group portfolio. Build CoE capability and capacity to support Group growth ambitions. 5. Team Leadership & Capability Lead and develop Project Coordinators, Business Analysts, Product Analysts, and Squad Leads. Build a high-performance, delivery-oriented culture. Define clear roles, expectations, and growth pathways for CoE talent. Operate the QA Engineer function as a quality gate across all CoE squads. 6. Any additional or related activities requested by Management within his/her competence and expertise. LEVEL OF EDUCATION Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration with IT focus, or related discipline. LEVEL OF EXPERIENCE More than 12 years across delivery management, programme management, or AI / data operations, with at least 5–7 years leading multi-squad delivery organisations. Demonstrable experience running an AI / data / analytics CoE or equivalent delivery factory at scale. Proven track record converting bespoke delivery into reusable IP and growing cross-business deployment. Experience operating in a services environment with utilisation, throughput, and quality accountability. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS REQUIRED Operational Excellence: sets and maintains a predictable, measurable delivery rhythm. Reuse Mindset: instinctively asks “build once, deploy many” rather than starting from scratch. Servant Leadership: unblocks squads, removes friction, and protects delivery focus. Stakeholder Management: partners effectively with functional Directors who own standards while owning execution. Results Orientation: measured by throughput, on-time delivery, reuse, and CoE engagement. Diverse and Multicultural Collaboration: effective across the Axian Middle East and Africa footprint. SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS: TECHNICAL TOOLS Delivery Tooling: expert in Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, or equivalent portfolio and squad tooling. Agile & Delivery Methods: mastery of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and hybrid delivery patterns. Reporting & Analytics: comfortable with Power BI / Tableau for CoE operational dashboards. CoE & Reuse Platforms: familiarity with template libraries, design systems, and reuse marketplaces. Collaboration: fluent in Microsoft 365, Teams, and modern collaboration platforms. Data & AI Awareness: sufficient technical fluency to challenge delivery quality and engineering choices. LANGUAGE SKILLS Essential: fluent English (written and verbal). Essential: fluent French (written and verbal); the role is customer-facing across francophone clients and operating companies, and both languages are required at native or near-native level. OTHER REQUIREMENTS Telco Sector Experience: Essential. Direct experience delivering data, AI, or technology programmes inside a telecommunications operator, vendor, or systems integrator serving telco clients. Deep Knowledge of the Middle East and Africa Ecosystem: understanding of regional delivery realities, talent landscape, and client expectations. High Availability and Geographical Mobility: willingness to travel across clusters and CoE delivery sites. Leadership of Complex Delivery Programs: proven ability to lead multi-squad delivery factories in excess of USD 10M annual throughput.

review_candidates.title: Systemingenjör till Ictech i Linköping
review_candidates.description: Gillar du att förstå hur hela systemet hänger ihop, inte bara en enskild del? Vi söker nu fler erfarna systemingenjörer till vårt team i Linköping. Rollen kan se lite olika ut beroende på din bakgrund, men gemensamt är att du har en stark teknisk grund och trivs med att arbeta med komplexa system. Du kanske har en bakgrund inom embedded- eller mjukvaruutveckling och har rört dig mer mot systemnivå. Eller så arbetar du idag med exempelvis systemdesign, krav, integration eller verifiering. Vad kan du jobba med hos oss? I våra uppdrag kan du bland annat arbeta med: systemdesign och tekniska lösningar kravanalys och nedbrytning av systemkrav integration och verifiering gränssnitt mellan mjukvara, hårdvara och olika delsystem tekniska vägval, analys och felsökning samarbete med utvecklare, testare och andra teknikområden Den exakta rollen varierar mellan uppdragen. Det viktiga för oss är att du kan se både detaljerna och den större tekniska helheten. Vem söker vi? Vi tror att du har minst 7 års erfarenhet av teknisk systemutveckling eller ett närliggande område. Din bakgrund kan exempelvis finnas inom embedded systems, mjukvaruutveckling, systems engineering, integration eller verifiering. Vi ser gärna att du: har erfarenhet av teknisk produkt- eller systemutveckling har god förståelse för mjukvara och gärna samspelet mellan mjukvara och hårdvara har erfarenhet av C/C++, embedded Linux, RTOS, systemarkitektur, kravhantering eller safety critical systems är van att arbeta tillsammans med flera tekniska discipliner kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska Ictech Linköping Vi öppnade vårt Linköpingskontor år 2020 och är idag omkring 40 kollegor. Här finns många seniora ingenjörer med lång erfarenhet inom bland annat embedded, mjukvara och systemutveckling. Vi sitter i Ebbepark och lägger stor vikt vid både tekniskt utvecklande uppdrag och en bra gemenskap på kontoret, det ska helt enkelt vara riktigt kul att gå till jobbet! För oss handlar konsultrollen inte bara om att hitta ett uppdrag. Vi vill hitta rätt uppdrag utifrån din erfarenhet, vad du tycker är roligt och vart du vill utvecklas framåt. Alltid med kvalitet och långsiktighet i tanken. Nyfiken? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vår resa i Linköping! Vid frågor, kontakta dino.samlija@ictech.se Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig över en kaffe på vårt kontor i Ebbepark!

review_candidates.title: Senior Editor (German-Language)
review_candidates.description: Paradise Media is a fast-growing performance marketing company behind some of the most successful affiliate and iGaming brands in the world. We run a global network of high-authority sites across casino, sports, and entertainment built on data, experimentation, and top-tier SEO. We’re a private company with strong capital reserves and no outside investors, making us a stable, independent, and fast-moving place to grow your career. You’ll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, have a real voice in strategy, and see your ideas go live fast. We’re scaling quickly to become one of the largest privately-owned companies in iGaming. A team where smart, driven people can have a massive impact and build something enduring. About The Role The Senior DACH Editor is a high-impact position where you will manage a heavy flow of content. You will be responsible for producing high-quality, engaging, and compliant content that supports Paradise Media’s iGaming brands and global content strategy. This role combines deep iGaming expertise, SEO-driven writing, and strict adherence to regulatory and editorial standards. You’ll work closely with the Head of SEO and collaborate with writers, editors, SEO teams, and content leads to ensure that every piece of content aligns with performance objectives, brand tone, and compliance requirements. This position suits a results-oriented German-language Editor who thrives in a data-informed, fast-paced environment. This role can be based in Malta (hybrid) or remote within other European countries. Roles & Responsibilities Edit new content to ensure it meets brand voice, quality standards, and regional nuances. Update existing content to maintain relevance, accuracy, and ranking power. Use AI when requested to increase the editorial output without it affecting content negatively. Ensure all content meets legal, advertising, and responsible gaming guidelines across relevant geos. Ensure content passes plagiarism detection and AI detection software. Follow and implement the best SEO practices for the DACH market, including crafting compelling meta tiles, meta descriptions and H1s. Execute internal linking strategies to boost site authority and improve site navigation, Be able to work on edits and formatting directly in WordPress when needed. Know how to work with SurferSEO, Copyscape, Originality, Ahrefs, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc. Use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, generate drafts or perform data-driven content audits. Work within a KPI-driven framework to meet output volume and quality benchmarks. Brownie Points For Knowledge of Google Search Console, Agentic AI tools and ClickUp Additional Responsibilities Keep up-to-date with industry trends, developments, and regulatory changes to provide relevant and timely content. Communicate clearly and timely with the respective team members Contribute to brainstorming sessions and strategic discussions to identify content growth and improvement opportunities. Perform any additional tasks or roles as needed by the department. Commit to a minimum of 30 hours but not more than 40 hours per week given the company is able to provide consistent workload Train junior writers and editors if needed. Requirements 3+ years of experience producing high-performing SEO content in German, with strong expertise in both sports betting and online casinos. Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed, cross-functional teams. Native German speaker with excellent grammar, natural writing flow, and deep DACH cultural insight, delivering consistent, high-quality German content within structured content systems. Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining editorial and brand standards. Our Benefits We offer a competitive salary, and the opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

review_candidates.title: Clinical Research Associate / Senior CRA
review_candidates.description: Innovation starts from the heart. Edwards Lifesciences is the global leader of patient-focused innovations for structural heart disease and critical care monitoring. With millions of patients served in over 100 countries, each team makes a meaningful contribution by improving patient outcomes and discovering lasting solutions for unmet patient needs. Imagine how your ideas and expertise can change a patient’s life. We generate extensive clinical evidence to demonstrate the effectiveness and safety of our innovations and how our products transform patients’ lives. As part of our Clinical Affairs team, you’ll hone your scientific curiosity and passion for evaluating data to increase access to pioneering technologies for patients in need. In close partnership with principal investigators, dedicated medical professionals, patient advocacy groups, and regulatory authorities, you will drive the evidence needed to optimize patient outcomes. We have 2 roles available as Clinical Research Associates (or Senior CRAs depending on experience): Germany - based around Munich, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Stuttgart, Cologne and surrounding areas France - Flexible locations Our clinical monitoring roles require travel national travel for monitoring visits, as well as some travel within the wider European region. This role will be responsible for site monitoring activities to ensure the overall integrity of study implementation and adherence to study protocol at assigned clinical sites. This role will be to work on medical device trials in Cardiology. How you will make an impact: Conducting Clinical Monitoring activities at sites across Germany Serve as key contact to assigned clinical sites throughout the study process Is accountable for achieving and reporting on agreed clinical milestones Supports study team in the interactions with Ethics Committees and Competent Authorities Participates actively to project team meetings, as required Close collaboration with internal stakeholders to ensure proper project conduct Assist in Providing site and Edwards personnel training including preparation/maintenance of study documents, completion of forms, understanding of examinations/assessments required Reporting site enrollment progress including device accountability and protocol deviations (inclusion/exclusion criteria, sequential enrollment) 6. Collecting completed Case Report Forms (CRF) and collecting, confirming and auditing supporting documentation. Processing adverse events Document procedural case observations for insights in investigating post procedural events Data review, safety reporting and complaint handling Identifying and reporting adverse events and device-related complications in accordance with regulatory and internal requirements Develop new improved processes and perform implementation Ensures Audit readiness for internal, external and site Audits Other incidental duties as assigned by management What you will need (required): Bachelor's Degree in a related field, and/or proven record of strong relevant experience. Previous related medical device and/or clinical experience required Previous clinical trial site monitoring experience in Germany within a Medical Device or Pharmaceutical setting. Experience of different types of monitoring visits and in different study stages. Quality assurance and regulatory compliance in a clinical research setting Driving licence required Fluency in both English and local language (French or German as applicable) is essential. What else we look for (preferred): Excellent communication and organizational skills Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and ability to operate general office machinery Good written and verbal communication skills, presentation, and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills Good problem-solving and critical thinking skills Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e.g., pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control Cardiology and/or medical device study experience desirable.

review_candidates.title: Technical Engineer - Public Cloud
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world to and through our global hub in Dubai and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers Fly Better. Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world's largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-edge information and technology team as a Technical Engineer - Public Cloud. Join our Platform Engineering team, the backbone of our cloud modernization journey. We architect and engineer next generation cloud platforms that unify control across datacentres, networks, public and private cloud environments. review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer — Video Streaming Platform
review_candidates.description: About Seera Seera is an Arabic-language microdrama streaming platform built for the MENA market. We produce and distribute short-form vertical series and monetize through a hybrid model of in-app coins and subscriptions. We're a small founding team with a distributed engineering group across Eastern Europe and the Caucasus, scaling the platform to handle rapid growth in viewers, content, and transactions. The role You'll own a large share of Seera's backend: the APIs that power our mobile and web apps, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. You'll work directly with the CTO and our engineering manager, and you'll shape how we architect video delivery, payments, and content operations as we grow from thousands to millions of users. This is a senior, high-ownership role — we're looking for someone who has already built and operated systems at scale and wants to do it again with more autonomy. What you'll do Design, build, and maintain backend APIs for content catalog, playback, accounts, entitlements, coin wallets, and subscriptions Own our AWS environment end to end: architecture, IaC, IAM, networking, cost management, observability, and CI/CD Build and operate the video pipeline — ingest, transcoding, packaging (HLS/DASH), DRM, and CDN delivery — optimized for mobile networks across MENA Integrate third-party services (payments, carrier billing, ad mediation, analytics) reliably and securely Establish monitoring, alerting, and on-call practices for a consumer streaming product Raise the engineering bar: technical design docs, code review, and mentoring across a distributed team What we're looking for 5–8 years building production backend systems, with at least some of that on consumer products at meaningful scale Deep hands-on AWS experience - ECS/EKS or Lambda, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, MediaConvert Experience with video systems, transcoding, adaptive bitrate streaming, CDN configuration, or DRM strongly preferred Strong judgment on API design, auth, data modeling, caching, and performance under load Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, async-first team across multiple time zones Professional working proficiency in English; Arabic is a plus but not required Nice to have Payments or subscription billing systems Prior startup or 0→1 experience What we offer Full-time employment with direct ownership of core infrastructure at an early-stage streaming company Fully remote within Eastern Europe, Azerbaijan or MENA Salary 2.000USD/month
